characters.name: KATI
characters.description: Väike inimene, rõõmsameelne tüdruk, heledad juuksed patsidega, seljas roosa kleit ja valged sukapüksid. Suured uudishimulikud silmad ja sõbralik rõõmsameelne näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: ANTS
characters.description: Väike inimene, rõõmsameelne poiss, lühikesed pruunid juuksed, seljas sinine T-särk ja pruunid lühikesed püksid. Suured rõõmsameelsed silmad ja lahke naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Mängutuba
locations.description: Cozy children's playroom with light blue walls, a wooden floor partially covered by a colorful striped rug, and a single large window on the back wall showing a sunny spring garden with green grass, a few tiny spring flowers and a small bird perched on a tree branch. In the center is a small round wooden table with two small wooden chairs. A low green shelf filled with colorful toys and craft supplies stands against the left wall. Children's drawings of various friendly animals are pinned on the light blue walls. Bright and cheerful lighting. Cute cartoonish children's book illustration style, landscape orientation.
